svg.title: Dandelion Crown — step 3: Wrap, then lay the stem alongside
svg.desc: Keep pinching the crossing. Bring the hanging stem up and around the first stem, passing it between the two flower heads. Fold its long tail back to the right, alongside the first stem. Gently snug the loop under the heads without pulling it tight enough to snap.

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wrap up, then lay the tail alongside

svg.text: Follow the teal stem through one complete loop.
